metadata.source: See sources below; rates checked 3 Nov 2026
metadata.rate_year: Forestry Grant Scheme rates as published 1 Oct 2024 (Woodland Improvement Grant) and 6 Oct 2025 (woodland creation capital items)

sources.restocking_grant_per_ha: Woodland Improvement Grant – Restructuring Regeneration, 'Delivering Diversity and Resilience Woodland' £550/ha (min 20% other species; PAWS conversion scores extra), ruralpayments.org, published 1 Oct 2024. Replaces £2,400/ha (a woodland-creation figure).
sources.deer_fencing_grant_per_m: FGS capital item, high-cost deer fence £9.90/m, ruralpayments.org Woodland Creation page updated 6 Oct 2025. Eligibility alongside Restructuring Regeneration to be confirmed with Scottish Forestry.
sources.tree_protection_per_tree: FGS capital item, tree shelter 1.2–1.8 m £2.00, ruralpayments.org updated 6 Oct 2025. Eligibility for restocking to be confirmed.
sources.rhododendron_clearance_per_ha: Not verified (WIG Habitats and Species standard costs).
sources.timber: Assumptions. Reference: GB coniferous standing sales average £34.28 per m3 overbark, year to Sep 2025 (Forest Research Timber Price Indices).
sources.esg_and_long_term_values: Indicative assumptions, not sourced. England's statutory Biodiversity Net Gain does not apply in Scotland.

sitka_spruce.label: Sitka Spruce
sitka_spruce.note: Lower value softwood; commonest PAWS species in Fife

larch.label: Larch
larch.note: Good timber value; significant Phytophthora disease risk flags may apply

fgs_grants.note: Scottish Forestry Grant Scheme rates (see metadata.sources)
fgs_grants.note_regen: Applies a 70% factor to the restocking rate for natural regeneration (assumption, not verified)

costs.note_fencing: Real-world contractor rate; FGS grant covers ~82% of this
costs.note_tree: Bare-root native broadleaf whips, including stakes and guards
costs.note_diy_fencing: Materials only — assumes landowner provides labour
costs.note_diy_planting: Materials only — bare-root whips, no contractor planting labour

esg.note: Private nature-finance sponsorship (e.g. distilleries, corporates); indicative assumption. WCC carbon credits NOT applicable to PAWS restocking. England's statutory BNG does not apply in Scotland.

long_term_values.note: 15-year projected annual values per hectare of restored broadleaf woodland
long_term_values.note_bng: Annualised voluntary biodiversity credit value assuming a 30-year agreement; indicative assumption (statutory BNG is England-only).
